description:
Intent i017 (branch=if-alt-count, snapshot s04) complete. Two findings written to /mnt/raid/home/yangshuangning/vuln_variant_search/experiments/clairvoyant_variant_search/runs/10_cluster/C8/agent-state/findings/i017.json, both verified with literal source quotes:

FINDING 1 (high confidence) s04:drivers/media/usb/gspca/stv06xx/stv06xx.c:314-348, quote 'alt = &gspca_dev->dev->actconfig->intf_cache[0]->altsetting[1];' — UNTRUSTED SOURCE: actconfig->intf_cache[] altsetting array is sized (kzalloc, drivers/usb/core/config.c:698-699) purely from the attacker-controlled gadget's configuration descriptors; usb_parse_configuration recomputes counts from raw descriptors with only dev_warn. MISSING GUARANTEE: stv06xx_isoc_init (line 320) and stv06xx_isoc_nego (line 333) index intf_cache[0]->altsetting[1] with a literal 1 and never check num_altsetting >= 2 or altsetting[1].desc.bNumEndpoints >= 1 (grep of stv06xx.c shows zero num_altsetting/bNumEndpoints checks). UNSAFE USE: alt->endpoint[0].desc.wMaxPacketSize is read and WRITTEN (321-322, 334, 342) then usb_set_interface(dev, iface, 1) at 344; hooks are invoked by the gspca core at VIDIOC_STREAMON (gspca.c:852-853, 957-958) before any core-side alt validation applies to the subdriver's hardcoded index. A one-altsetting gadget spoofing Logitech VID/PIDs yields an OOB 16-bit write past the usb_interface_cache allocation at first stream start.

FINDING 2 (medium confidence) s04:drivers/media/usb/gspca/xirlink_cit.c:2635-2691, same sd_isoc_init/sd_isoc_nego pattern (altsetting[1] at 2653/2676, wMaxPacketSize patched at 2654/2684, usb_set_interface at 2686) with no validation anywhere in the file.

Bounded negatives classified: usbvision-video.c:1443 safe (all 67 model .interface entries are -1 or 0; interface[0] always allocated when probe runs); em28xx-audio.c:763 safe (num_altsetting <= alt checked, endpoint loop bounded); em28xx-cards.c:3429 safe; ftdi_sio.c:1886 and usb-serial.c:832 safe (pointer identity / guarded deref); gspca.c:850 core safe (num_altsetting>1 guard at 890); sound/usb fixed-altsetting sites safe (explicit num_altsetting guards at pcm.c:297, quirks.c:221/432, mixer_quirks.c:1523, midi.c:1945/1990, ua101.c:926). Unresolved (in limitations): m920x.c:474 and pwc-if.c:381 usb_altnum_to_altsetting result NULL-handling not fully read. No build or gadget reproducer was run (read-only snapshot); findings are structural source hypotheses matching the seed's descriptor-count-vs-assumed-index invariant at the altsetting level.
